points.name: 也许/甚至/尽管/恐怕/由于 — modal & evidential adverbs
points.explain: These adverbs go before the verb to color how certain or emphatic a statement is: 也许 ("maybe"), 甚至 ("even"), 尽管 ("despite/although"), 恐怕 ("I'm afraid that..."), 由于 ("due to", like a more formal 因为).

sentences.en: Despite being very busy, he still comes.

sentences.zh: 由于天气不好我们不去
sentences.en: Due to bad weather, we won't go.
He knows at least five people.
